mapper.select: SELECT r.emoji , count(er.*) AS count, #{email} = ANY(ARRAY_AGG(u.email)) AS reacted FROM reactions r JOIN auth.users u ON r.users_id = u.id WHERE r.reference_type = CAST(#{referenceType} AS emoji_reference_type) AND r.reference_id = #{id} GROUP BY r.emoji
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reactions ( users_id, reference_type, reference_id, emoji ) SELECT u.id, CAST(#{data.referenceType} AS emoji_reference_type), #{data.referenceId}, #{data.emoji} FROM auth.users u WHERE u.email = #{email};
